findings.title: Queried accepted non-thread operations lose their last active-budget release path
evidence: Recovery read invokes reconcileOperation; accepted reconciliation invokes updateOperation, without acknowledgement.
Api normal successful non-thread writes invoke acknowledgeOperation, but receipt-query completion is a separate path.
Capacity GC collects not_sent or accepted consumed nonlegacy records. consumeThreadOperations only consumes input/fork/convert/review thread records.

OperationHistory no longer offers manual completed-record cleanup. Thus accepted provider/configuration operations confirmed after unknown can accumulate to the active cap with no matching thread to open.
Migrated accepted legacy thread records cannot be marked consumed by the current consumer, so removal of manual closure also needs a safe retention exit for those records.
findings.suggestedBoundary: Add safe automatic collection eligibility for accepted receipts that require no further owner handoff; keep terminal/recovery owner payload and unseen thread destinations until consumed. Do not immediately erase the proof before useWorkflow observers can read it; do not clear legacy/unsent/newer drafts.
findings.validation: Static end-to-end caller proof only; no new test or runtime reproduction performed by this reviewer.
